---
name: Enhancement
about: An idea for something the kit should do or do differently
title: "[enhancement] "
labels: needs-triage
---

- [ ] **the gap**: one line, what the kit does not cover today
- [ ] **what you would change**: the behavior or output you want instead
- [ ] **which file or script**: the part of the kit this touches
- [ ] **why it is generic**: why this would help any operator, not just your
      own search

Do not include your own data, preferences, or anything specific to one job
search. This is for changes to the generic tooling only.
